在交接件中加入「LLNL 平行計算：架構、所有權與資料介面」的原始資料、計算版本及下列驗收逐項結果：P4速度3.3333、效率.8333；四核心秒144相對單核心120顯示額外成本；對介面圖逐一標明輸入、輸出、單位與來源；實際架構敘述和合成量測必須分欄。
以本課決策條件作有條件結論：畫固定格點數與P變化，列每案TP、S、E及P×TP，避免效率與吞吐混用；兩效率可重算且問題固定，報告保留速度、效率與資源時間不同單位。 請接手者依同一輸入重作一項檢查，保留差異與未結案項。
steps.instructionEn:
Deliver strong-scaling curves, equal-work manifests, and resource comparisons.
Include raw data, calculation revision, and each acceptance result for LLNL parallel computing: architecture,ownership and data interfaces: At P = 4, speedup is 3.3333 and efficiency is 0.8333. The run uses 144 core-seconds versus the baseline 120. Label inputs, outputs, units and provenance; separate sourced architecture from synthetic observations.
Use the course decision condition for a conditional conclusion: Draw fixed grid size with varying P. Tabulate TP, S, E, and P×TP separately. Reproduce both efficiencies with fixed work. Distinguish speedup, efficiency, and resource-time units. Ask the receiving role to repeat one check with the same inputs and retain discrepancies and open issues.
steps.observation: 接手者能從輸入重現驗收，且剩餘風險有負責人。P4速度3.3333、效率.8333；四核心秒144相對單核心120顯示額外成本；對介面圖逐一標明輸入、輸出、單位與來源；實際架構敘述和合成量測必須分欄。
steps.observationEn: A receiving role can reproduce acceptance from inputs and identify the owner of residual risks. At P = 4, speedup is 3.3333 and efficiency is 0.8333. The run uses 144 core-seconds versus the baseline 120. Label inputs, outputs, units and provenance; separate sourced architecture from synthetic observations.

knowledge.title: 案例與來源邊界
knowledge.text: 平行計算教學區分速度提升與效率；本課在固定問題上比較實際用量。
knowledge.textEn: Parallel-computing tutorials distinguish speedup from efficiency. This lesson compares resource use on one fixed problem.

knowledge.title: 可驗證的工程目標
knowledge.text: 畫固定格點數與P變化，列每案TP、S、E及P×TP，避免效率與吞吐混用；兩效率可重算且問題固定，報告保留速度、效率與資源時間不同單位。
knowledge.textEn: Draw fixed grid size with varying P. Tabulate TP, S, E, and P×TP separately. Reproduce both efficiencies with fixed work. Distinguish speedup, efficiency, and resource-time units.

knowledge.title: 模型、介面與適用範圍
knowledge.text: S(P)=T1/TP，E=S/P；必須同一問題、正確性與計時邊界。
knowledge.textEn: S(P) = T1/TP and E = S/P require the same problem, correctness criterion, and timing boundaries.
